notes.title: New Year's update is out!
notes.notes:
The release is finally out in new year! 🥳

Containing all the mentioned features of the previous article, the new version of Where is the Tutorial is out now. On top of the mentioned list, Olympic Hamster & Co. has also hidden some extra content, we encourage veteran players to look out for it!

With that said, the updated promotional content will take some extra time to make, but you can bet, here at Olympic Hamster & Co. are cooking the best of the bestest marketing you can imagine (please don't get your expectations too high).

Olympic Hamster & Co. wishes all a happy 2️⃣0️⃣2️⃣5️⃣ and hope to see you, yes YOU soon!

notes.title: Where is the Tutorial is getting a major update!
notes.notes:
This winter, Where is the Tutorial will have a new, extense and overall incredible update including all the helpful feedback recieved since its release!

Keeping the game healthily frustrating, the update, focused on the quality of life of the experience will include such remarkable features as:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059351/c31cf8ff3c8777081780b22a7e30e2f5130c778f.png

Summary with more in depth information about the update:


a brand new mysterious lever!
new textures and map details!
upgrades on the UI, with improvements on the graphics.
easier and more intuitive mechanics, such as indicators to help out the player task's.
fixes to some of the game's bugs, such as achivements not registering properly.
and much more...

Here at Olympic Hamster & Co. we know how long it took to release the update, but we promise to deliver with this overall improvement on the game, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do. So if you are still reading, and interested on the premise of this no-tutorial game, give it a chance!

We have already released full support for MacOS, and you can expect more updates on the way (although maybe not as fast as Olympic Hamster & Co. wished to deliver).

This update will be released around New Year's date, so expect it sooner rather than later!
